verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order (headline, steps 01–03, CTA) and every line is legible, but it is a shrunk copy. Its left edges are ragged: the logo, headline, steps and CTA each start at a different x. The type is small, the bag is tiny and there is too much dead space. B gives the bag and headline strong hierarchy, but the three steps are microscopic and out of order (02, 01, 03). The steps are scattered around the CTA, the eyebrow floats beside the button, and the logo has shrunk to a footer dot.

A is orderly and readable but ragged: the logo, headline, steps and CTA sit at different left edges. It is undersized, with large empty areas. In B the steps are unreadable slivers, scattered and out of sequence (01 at the top right, 02 and 03 at the bottom). The footer legal text floats inside the circle at the top right, the eyebrow is stranded in the top-left corner, and the logo is crammed beside the CTA.

A has a strong headline, bag and CTA, but the step copy is microscopic and out of order (01, then 03, then 02 at the bottom). The logo badge sits in the middle of the steps zone, and the footer text sits right under the CTA. B is readable and in the correct order, but it is a scaled-down copy with misaligned left edges and wasted space.

A shrinks the product bag and logo to thumbnails beside the CTA, so the brand is lost. The steps are illegible and scattered (02 and 03 at the top, 01 at the bottom right), the legal footer sits at the top, and the eyebrow sits below the headline. B is readable and in order, but it is a shrunk original with ragged alignment, small type and empty space.
